name: Jan Novotny
bio:
Jan Novotny's journey into motorsport started unconventionally. While running a successful auto repair shop in Prague, he developed a fascination with the engineering intricacies of racing vehicles. He volunteered at local racing events, initially as a mechanic, quickly showcasing a sharp eye for detail and a knack for optimizing car performance. This led to an opportunity to manage a small regional racing team, where he honed his leadership and strategic skills.

As Team Principal, Jan believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. He emphasizes clear communication and data-driven decision-making, striving for continuous improvement in all aspects of team operations. His hands-on approach and dedication make him a respected figure in the paddock, despite his relatively recent entry into the higher echelons of motorsport management. He is known for his innovative problem-solving, often finding cost-effective solutions that provide a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a traditional Czech kolach (pastry) before every race.
